newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales very slow at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales very slow at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry and demand was moderate. Feedlots very current.

Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 200 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 81,600 head confirmed including 14,900 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 69.00. Slaughter heifers - Pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1210 lb heifers, heiferettes and cows 66.00.
